response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled Staff Software Engineer with over a decade of full-stack and distributed systems experience, but falls significantly short of the core requirement of 8+ years of AI-specific development. While he has recently engaged with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP, the absence of extensive Python experience, vector databases, RAG architectures, and long-term production AI delivery makes him an unsuitable fit for a senior GenAI-focused forward deployed role.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience across full-stack, distributed systems, and open-source platforms.
Proven track record at the Staff level, demonstrating technical leadership and strong engineering practices like TDD and CI/CD.
Recent exposure to agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP), aligning with the preferred qualifications.
concerns: Lacks the required minimum 8 years of experience specifically building AI-driven solutions.
No mention of Python, vector databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Limited evidence of leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions for enterprise AI delivery.
